response.question: Why did activation fall last week?
response.summary: Activation fell substantially between the two documented signup cohorts. Before activation: 54.8333 %; After activation: 33 %; Activation change: -21.8333 pp. The activation decline is arithmetically accounted for mainly by a shift in acquisition channel mix toward lower-activating channels. evidence.sql:
WITH starts AS (
  SELECT e.user_id, e.practice_session_id, MIN(e.event_at) AS started_at
  FROM events e JOIN users u USING(user_id)
  WHERE e.event_type='practice_start' AND e.practice_session_id <> ''
    AND e.event_at >= u.signup_at AND e.event_at < u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.practice_session_id
), completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id FROM events e
  JOIN starts s ON e.user_id=s.user_id AND e.practice_session_id=s.practice_session_id
  JOIN users u ON e.user_id=u.user_id
  WHERE e.event_type='practice_complete' AND e.event_at >= s.started_at
    AND e.event_at < u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
), cohort AS (
  SELECT u.*, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM starts s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS started,
    CASE WHEN c.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed
  FROM users u LEFT JOIN completions c USING(user_id)
  WHERE u.signup_at >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.signup_at < CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY <= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
) SELECT COUNT(*) denominator, COALESCE(SUM(started),0) started, COALESCE(SUM(completed),0) numerator FROM cohort

response.question: Which countries contributed to the sales change?
response.summary: The United Kingdom was the largest contributor to the sales increase between the two months. United Kingdom: Sales change contribution: 386,371.2 GBP. Several countries including Japan, EIRE, and Norway also contributed positively to the sales change. Japan: Sales change contribution: 6,512.04 GBP; EIRE: Sales change contribution: 6,420.51 GBP; Norway: Sales change contribution: 2,840.27 GBP. Some countries such as the Netherlands, Australia, and Singapore contributed negatively to the sales change. Netherlands: Sales change contribution: -14,834.64 GBP; Australia: Sales change contribution: -9,907.81 GBP; Singapore: Sales change contribution: -7,067.32 GBP. The total sales change is the sum of all country contributions, confirming an accounting decomposition rather than causal attribution. Sales change: 354,517.03 GBP.

retrieval.title: Country contribution to sales change
retrieval.text: Subtract October 2011 gross positive sales from November 2011 for each country. Country contributions sum to the total change. Countries absent in one month contribute zero in that month. This is an accounting decomposition, not causal attribution.

retrieval.title: Source and quality boundaries
retrieval.text: UCI Online Retail by Daqing Chen (2015), DOI 10.24432/C5BW33, CC BY 4.0. Public historical UK retailer transactions from December 2010 to December 2011. Exact duplicate rows are retained and counted because no source line ID proves which repeated lines are erroneous. Only complete October and November 2011 are compared.

retrieval.title: Gross positive sales in GBP
retrieval.text: Sum Quantity times UnitPrice for invoice lines with positive quantity and price, excluding cancellation invoices starting C. This is gross positive sales, not net revenue, profit, or causal uplift. Missing customer identifiers do not exclude a valid sales line.

FROM retail WHERE month IN (?, ?) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SUM(CASE WHEN month=? THEN gross_sales_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS after_gbp
FROM retail WHERE month IN (?, ?) GROUP BY country ORDER BY country

baseline.preprocessing_advantage: A deterministic controller selects and executes the relevant analytical tools before the one answer call. This gives the baseline correct tool selection and precomputed arithmetic; it is not a raw-data, unaided LLM baseline.
baseline.boundary_policy: Deterministic unsupported/clarification cases use zero model calls in both arms.
baseline.comparison_scope: Complete analytical system versus fixed-preprocessing single-pass summarizer; does not isolate LangGraph or dynamic planning.
baseline.budget: Both arms use the same per-request provider limit and conservative request reservation. The agent can spend several calls selecting tools; the baseline spends one answer call.

agent.cost_basis: Pinned token pricing; failures without confirmed usage retain the provider gateway conservative upper bound.
